حُقٌّ : see حُقَّةٌ. ―
-b2- Also The breast, or mamma, of an old woman. (TA.) ―
-b3- A tuber of a truffle. (TA.) ―
-b4- The small hollow upon the head of the shoulder-blade: (K:) or, as some say, the حُقّ of the shoulder-blade is the head of the upper arm, in which is the وَابِلَة: (TA:) or this latter is another signification of حُقّ. (K.) ―
-b5- The head, (K,) or lower part of the head, (TA,) of the hip, in which is the thigh-bone; (K, TA;) the socket, or turning-place, of the hip. (TA.) ―
-b6- The socket, or turning-place, of the foot of a door. (TA.) You say, لَقِيتُهُ عِنْدَ حُقِّ بَابِ المَسْجِدِ, meaning I met him, or found him, near to the mosque: and المَسْجِدِ ↓ لَقِيتُهُ مِنْ حَاقِّ [app. means the same]. (TA.) ―
-b7- See also حَاقٌّ, in two places. ―
-b8- Also The web of a spider. (Az, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
